name: upgrade-in-production

sessions.prompt: Run the deconstruct skill. Continue my workflow.

expected_output: The Improve message, alone; nothing changes.

expectations.text: The AI says "This workflow already has a Design Plan, so changes to its requirements go through Improve. Say 'run the improve skill'."

check.text: This workflow already has a Design Plan, so changes to its requirements go through Improve. Say 'run the improve skill'.

expectations.text: Deconstruct does not re-run: no AI message says the Deconstruct opening (the 10.0 opening or 9.1's)

check.pattern: Deconstruct turns this workflow into a clear, testable description of what it must do|This is the most thorough conversation in the framework

expectations.text: No loss: `framework/*` is byte-identical before and after (every record file of the in-production workflow)
The AI gives the Improve message on its own (it may name the workflow) and starts no interview, design, build or test work
